page.layout: One block of centred title-page text, in lines, with a printer's fleuron below the last name block and the imprint at the foot. No margins, no running head, no page number.

main_text.l: ORIGINIS esse ipsam hominis lapsi naturam
talem: Et Philosophiæ verus usus & ab-
gensi, in solenni Promotionis XXIII. Candidatorum Actu,
Cum Praefatiuncula ad eximium & clariss. Phil. & Med.

page.notes: Ornamental fleuron (decorative border) between the Peucer line and the imprint; no text. The 'IN' and 'A' of the italic line are swash capitals, copied as the letters they represent. Italic words are set in italic type throughout the italic lines; the first italic line and the 'gensi' line are italic as printed.
